name: plain
note: Plain LLM: manual in the prompt, all tools, the model decides everything

name: plain+guard
note: Plain LLM, rule-violating tool calls blocked and returned as errors

name: tree
note: Decision-tree reasoning written into the prompt

name: decision-rules
